note: Destruction materials for every exported level. Change a number, re-export (BomArenaBoundaryBuilder.ExportAll), then run the OD-6 settle check before shipping. Ranges: toughness 0.25..4, blast_resistance 0..6, strip_thickness 0.1..0.6, shock_loss 1..12, flexibility 0.2..1. base is stone, wood, glass or rubber. To tune a built-in (stone, wood) on the tile levels, add an entry to builtin_overrides with a new name; parts that use that built-in then use it instead.
